messages:
sarah-support: Customer (acme-corp) reports SSO logins failing after yesterday's IdP cert rotation. All users get 403 on SAML ACS, customer attached assertion and edge logs.

acme-corp-admin: Login fails for everyone. Error in our IdP logs: RecipientCheckFailed and AssertionConsumerServiceURL mismatch. We recently changed nginx rewrite that adds a trailing slash to ACS (/auth/saml/consume -> /auth/saml/consume/).

sarah-support: Thanks — did they also rotate metadata or upload a new metadata XML? Any duplicate KeyDescriptor entries?

acme-corp-admin: We reuploaded metadata. The file has two <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries — the first looks like the old cert (expired), second is the new. IdP returns both.

mike-sre: Pulled the raw SAML response from our edge: 
``
SAMLResponse decode -> Recipient mismatch: expected https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs, got https://redwood.example.com/sso/ACS
Signature verification failed (no matching cert)
```

anjali-ps: Hmm — two things: (1) case sensitivity on ACS path (ACS vs acs) and trailing slash change could trigger recipient mismatch, (2) multiple KeyDescriptor order means our validator might pick wrong cert.

jordan-eng: Confirmed: our metadata verification code currently selects the first KeyDescriptor it finds for signature validation (legacy simplification). If the IdP includes the expired key first, verification fails. We don't iterate by default.

mike-sre: Workarounds for customer: request IdP to reorder KeyDescriptor so active key appears first or upload metadata with only the current key. Could also revert nginx rewrite to restore the original ACS URL.

sarah-support: Customer needs immediate access. Is there a tenant-scoped toggle we can flip to try all KeyDescriptors before rejecting?

jordan-eng: There isn't a public toggle today. I can prepare a canary patch to try additional KeyDescriptors during signature check, scoped to a tenant ID. Low risk but needs a short QA window. ETA ~3 hours if approved.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/saml-key-fallback -> staging (ci/build 3492)

mike-sre: Also recommend they normalize ACS URL canonicalization: our SP canonical ACS = https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs (lowercase, no trailing slash). Proxy rewrite should preserve case and strip trailing slash where possible.

acme-corp-admin: We'll revert the nginx change to remove trailing slash and re-upload a metadata XML that only contains the active KeyDescriptor. Once you enable the canary we'll test.

sarah-support: Plan: (1) acme revert nginx + reupload metadata with single key; (2) enable canary patch for their tenant; (3) test with 5 pilot users; (4) promote. I'll coordinate and log times.

jordan-eng: PR created: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1458 — adds KeyDescriptor fallback and lenient ACS normalization for canary. Posting updates here.

sarah-support: Thanks — keeping this warm. :pray:

jordan-eng: PR merged to canary, canary deploy started. Please send a new test assertion when ready.

acme-corp-admin: Ran test after revert + metadata reupload — SSO test succeeded for our test users (5/5). We'll schedule prod rollout tomorrow morning.

sarah-support: Great. Will wait for prod verification then close. Postmortem note: follow-up tickets for parser improvement (iterate KeyDescriptors by default) and stricter ACS normalization + better error messages to guide customers.

mike-sre: Filing incident triage doc and follow-up tickets (INC-2026, TKT-3421).
summary: Support thread: customer SSO failures after cert rotation caused by duplicate KeyDescriptor ordering and ACS path normalization. Canaried fallback fix and customer-side nginx revert resolved tests.
